messages:
ana: Quick alert 11: console quota card for proj-712 dropped sharply at 08:44 but request logs show calls from sa:replicator. Seems attribution flipped to project. Anyone familiar with the new routing policy `auth-route:prefer-origin`?
mike: I rolled that policy into canary this morning. It prefers X-Origin header over X-Effective-Identity to preserve billing semantics. Did you capture logs?
sylvia: Paste a sample row if possible. Want to see both headers and route tag.
ana: sample from logs:
```
ts=2024-09-18T08:43:58Z origin=proj-712 effective=sa:replicator route=auth-route:prefer-origin tokens=64 status=200
```
mike: Right1 the router set prefer-origin. Console widgets still show project-only aggregation, so the SA-level meter appears to drop while project meter rises.
sylvia: Proposal: emit both telemetry tags on each event (origin_project and effective_identity) and write to two topics `quota.project` and `quota.identity`. Quota service should read identity when flag `tenant_prefers_eid`=true per-tenant; fallback to project otherwise.
ana: Agree. UX: add a small "Attribution: PROJECT" badge on the quota card with a hover that shows "SA preview" and a modal with projected delta. That helps CS explain to customers.
mike: I'll add the router change to always propagate EID as a metric tag (ETA 6h). Pipeline dup stream (ETA 4h). Quota service flag + tests (ETA 8h). sylvia: I'll mock the badge and modal and wire a preview API that calls the reconciliation job.
infra-bot: Action recorded: auth-route:prefer-origin canary paused by ana at 08:47 UTC.
man: Owners: mike (router + pipeline), sylvia (console + preview API), ana (postmortem + customer comms). Leave thread open for PR links and diff CSV.
